_comment: Stan CPM test log-loss as published, read off Marformer-Paper/PLOTS/REAL-LLMRUBRIC/llmrubric_cpm_log_loss.png on 2026-10-05. The original fits were never migrated -- no numeric source for them survives anywhere on disk (D29), so the figure IS the reference. Values are digitised by eye and good to roughly +/-0.005, which is enough to detect a systematic shift but NOT enough to quote. Marformer's published curve is included for context; its K=10 point is above the broken axis and unreadable.
